description: Monrovia City (Liberia) - Existing Grid is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Columbia University Earth Institute. Grid electricity distribution line data from Liberia Electricity Corporation (LEC) within Monrovia city. The data was originally provided by LEC- in a CAD plan dated 2012 and converted to GIS compatible format by Earth Institute, Columbia University team. Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2012 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
